item.name: List Privileges Granted by Group to Current User

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/).</br>**Example:**`myorganization-bfghkjfjb674jh5egjk`

request.description:
Lists the [privileges](https://docs.coveo.com/en/228/) that are granted exclusively by the [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/) to the current user.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"GROUP","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2

variable.description:
(Required) The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

(Required) The unique identifier of the target [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/).</br>**Example:**`myorganization-bfghkjfjb674jh5egjk`
